episodes.title: Wake up babe, new doomsday cult just dropped
episodes.description:
Reacting to the video "The Internet's Deepest Rabbit Hole", which investigates a theosophic doomsday cult known as Allat-Ra and its bizzarre public facing figure Egon Cholakian. AllatRa is described as a "new religious movement" founded by the pseudo-prophet Igor Danilov in Ukraine.

Original video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6zLCZ_Ic1hI
